scope: KAN-158 UI v2 public specialist profile and profile-editor short description only

status_vocabulary.IMPLEMENTED: Runtime matches the v6.9.1 decision; covered by the cited PR evidence.
status_vocabulary.IMPLEMENTED WITH APPROVED DIFFERENCE: Implemented; the runtime deliberately differs from the prototype. The difference is recorded in the cited PR's evidence or requirement and was accepted when that PR was reviewed and merged. Activation should confirm these as the design's accepted runtime deviations.
status_vocabulary.NOT IMPLEMENTED: Present in the prototype, absent from runtime. Must not be presented as ready.
status_vocabulary.CONSISTENT (HIDDEN): The design hides the item without data; runtime also renders nothing without data.
status_vocabulary.CONTRACT RESOLVED DIFFERENCE: The design hid the item pending API confirmation; the public API already provides it and runtime shows it. Needs design acknowledgement. (No row uses this status after activation; kept for history.)
status_vocabulary.FUTURE / NOT APPROVED: Concept or explicitly not approved; correctly absent.
status_vocabulary.OPEN DIFFERENCE: Runtime differs from the v6.9.1 decision and no approval of the difference is recorded; needs a decision before or at activation. (No row uses this status after activation; kept for history.)
status_vocabulary.NOT RE-AUDITED: Not measured in this documentation task; left to the separate UX audit.
status_vocabulary.APPROVED OMISSION: Present in the prototype and deliberately not built; the omission was explicitly accepted by the product owner at activation.
status_vocabulary.APPROVED SEMANTIC DIFFERENCE: Runtime semantics differ from the prototype and the difference was explicitly accepted at activation. Not parity; any attached condition is tracked in open_conditions.
status_vocabulary.APPROVED DIFFERENCE: Runtime behaviour differs from the prototype and was explicitly accepted by the product owner at activation.
status_vocabulary.PARTIALLY VERIFIED: Some aspects are covered by cited merged evidence; the remaining aspects are listed as unverified and must not be read as validated.

rows.note: No format is selected on load in UI v2; UI v1 keeps its default highlight.
Prices beside each format in the panel; «від <мін.>» in the sticky bar and «N формати · від <мін.>» in the final CTA. «від» only when prices differ.

The chosen price is shown in the panel, sticky bar and final CTA. Without bookable time the sticky-bar context puts the price first («<ціна> · <формат>») so a 375px bar truncates the name, not the price. The offer_type sent equals the visible choice.

rows.design: IMPLEMENTATION_SPEC «Ціна й вибір»: «Обрати формат»; «Змінити» → focus BookingPanel
rows.note: The final CTA has no «Обрати формат» / «Змінити» links. The form's own «Змінити» for the chosen offer is pre-existing and is not this design element.
rows.decision: Accepted at activation 2026-10-26. Do not add «Обрати формат» / «Змінити» links to the final CTA. The existing consultation selector stays the primary way to change the choice.

rows.design: IMPLEMENTATION_SPEC «Режими»: «Продовжити · <дата>»; «Ціна й вибір»: format + time two-line summary
rows.note: Deliberately not introduced: selecting a slot opens the existing request form directly (approved booking contract). The form's selected-slot block replaces the two-line summary.
rows.decision: Accepted at activation 2026-10-26. Reconfirmed: a slot click opens the existing request form directly; no intermediate «Продовжити» step.

rows.note: Verified and preserved: «Обрати час» without a slot is active and scrolls to the slots (desktop) or opens the request sheet (phone). No disabled state was added.

Sticky bar: «Вільного часу зараз немає» for direct without slots, «Час — після запиту» for request_only. request_only never says «немає доступних вікон» (#75 fix preserved). The panel copy is neutral and has no specialist name forms.
Europe/Kyiv and legacy Europe/Kiev give «Час за Києвом»; other zones give «Ваш місцевий час · <IANA>». No Kyiv offset and no switcher.

A separate tinted card outside the booking panel at ≥1100 and in the page flow below that. #80 replaces per-row tinted 44px rows with one compact list. The copy targets stay ≥44px and the full values wrap naturally. The same contact data, visibility rules and actions are used.
rows.decision: Accepted at activation 2026-10-26. Reconfirmed: keep the compact contacts card accepted in PR #80.

rows.note: Navy block with one primary action; existing secondary actions render as text links. The heading follows the mode, and the offers line follows the choice (#78).

Bar with safe-area padding below 768px. Body padding equals the measured bar height and is restored on removal; the design's extra +24px reserve is not added. In the browser the footer ends above the bar at 375/390 (PR A evidence).
An initials tile with role=img for a missing or broken photo; a new URL retries.
The profile shows the full text without line-clamp in UI v2.

Two columns at ≥1100; one column with an inline panel at 768–1099; compact hero and sticky bar below 768. Differences: the existing 860px compactProfile stays for FAQ/native share; at viewport heights ≤700px the rail becomes static; real calendar controls may extend below the first tablet viewport.
Per PR C evidence: photo 88×110 (<768), 180×225 (768–799), 200×250 (800–1099); 56px source title at ≥1100 with long-word fitting, 40px on tablet.

rows.design: IMPLEMENTATION_SPEC «Розміри» (panel r28/padding 24, format 13/16 r16, slot grid, button 54px, FinalCta paddings)
rows.note: Not individually measured in this documentation task; left to the separate UX audit.
The UI v2 section navigation (pc2-profile-nav) predates phase 2 and was not changed or re-measured against v6.9.1.

Consultation offers in the profile rail are toggle buttons with aria-pressed (PublicProfileIdentityRail.vue). role=radiogroup exists only for the online/offline session-format choice in the slot filter. Needs a decision: accept the toggle-button pattern, or schedule a separate accessibility change.
rows.decision: Accepted at activation 2026-10-26. Keep the native <button type="button"> toggle pattern with aria-pressed. This is not radiogroup parity; the acceptance is conditional on keyboard and accessibility tests.
existing_evidence: Native buttons: keyboard focusable and activatable by Enter/Space by platform semantics (PublicProfileIdentityRail.vue).
Pointer selection updates aria-pressed (single pressed offer) in jsdom: src/views/PublicProfileView.spec.ts, KAN-158 phase 2 PR B tests (#78).
Chromium: the chosen offer is reflected in aria-pressed and sent as offer_type (docs/ui-v2/evidence/kan-158/phase2-pr-b/README.md).
open_conditions: No test yet activates a rail offer by keyboard (Tab to the button, Enter/Space) and asserts aria-pressed, the price summary and focus retention. Needs a separate runtime-test PR; this documentation PR cannot change tests.

rows.note: Days and slots use aria-pressed; focus-visible and reduced-motion handling exist. Only the items under verified are evidenced.
verified: Video dialog (#82, Chromium 375–1280): initial focus, 12 Tab + 12 Shift+Tab contained, Escape/Close/backdrop, focus return, scroll lock; phone runs with reduced motion.
Request sheet and About/Share overlays (#79, phase2-pr-c browser.cjs): Escape focus return, phone backdrop and Tab wrap.
unverified: focus-visible ring values (2px #12345A) on rail offers, days and slots against v6.9.1;
keyboard activation of rail offers (see accessibility-offers-radiogroup);
a reduced-motion audit of the profile page beyond the video dialog;
manual Safari, Firefox and screen-reader behaviour.

rows.note: «N / 160» counter; new or changed text over 160 cannot save. Differences: no native maxlength (no silent truncation of pasted text); Unicode code points are counted; unchanged legacy text over 160 is allowed and omitted from PATCH; no orange counter state after 140. Backend max_length stays 240, so 160 is enforced by this editor only.
Runtime renders FAQ only from existing profile section data; nothing is shown without data. FAQ as structured profile data remains a backend gate.

rows.design: CHANGELOG v6.9.1 §6 (hidden until confirmed in the public API)
rows.note: The public profile API already returns experience_years and languages (src/lib/api.ts), and runtime shows «Досвід» and «Мови» when they are present. Needs design acknowledgement at activation.
rows.decision: Accepted at activation 2026-10-26. Keep showing «Досвід» and «Мови» whenever the public API supplies valid data; do not hide them to match the prototype assumption.
